sources._transit_note: Basra to India west coast via Arabian Sea, ~10-14 days typical
Ras Tanura / Jubail to India west coast, ~8-12 days typical

route._note: ~70% of Saudi India-bound exports route via Ras Tanura (Hormuz). ~30% via Yanbu terminal (Red Sea / Bab-el-Mandeb), captured in red_sea_routing config.

sources._transit_note: Primorsk/Novorossiysk via Suez to India, ~25-30 days; Arctic route not currently used for India. Post-sanctions rerouting via Cape adds ~45 days.

route._note: Post-2022 India imports predominantly via shadow fleet. Suez Canal is primary artery; Cape of Good Hope (+15 days) used occasionally as alternate.

sources._transit_note: Das Island / ADCO fields to India west coast, ~6-10 days
US Gulf Coast (Houston/Corpus Christi) to India east/west coast, ~35-40 days via Cape or Suez

route._note: Most India-bound US cargoes route via Cape of Good Hope (~37 days). Some East Coast US shipments route via Suez (~30 days), but Gulf Coast origin makes Cape more common.

sources._transit_note: Bonny terminal to India west coast, ~20-25 days
Mina Al Ahmadi to India west coast, ~8-12 days
Weighted average of remaining minor suppliers (Oman, Mexico, Angola, etc.)

route._note: Composite entry. Oman/Angola primarily Hormuz; Mexico/Brazil via Cape of Good Hope.
